summary: Frontend-only smoke of the 3 P2 features on Rudaya Powers Finance Tracker. All three flows (Project Drilldown drawer, Copy Last Year Forecast, Backup P&L Impact) work end-to-end. Regression: all listed routes load without console errors (only pre-existing 'no routes matched' warnings for a couple of sidebar links that use different paths).

design_issues.screen: Sales Forecast / Copy Last Year dialog
issues: Target-year select options render labels like '2027 (from 2026)' and '2027 (from 2027)' — two options carry the same visible text prefix 2027, only differing in the suffix. This breaks accessible-name uniqueness and made get_by_role('option', name='2027') ambiguous in tests. Recommend using distinct values, e.g. '2027' and '2027 (self)' or hide the '(from 2027)' entry entirely.

action_items: Minor: dedupe/rename ambiguous year options in CopyLastYearDialog target-year select so each option has a unique visible label (helps a11y and test selection).

Pre-existing (not this iteration): react-router warnings 'No routes matched location "/dashboard" | "/forecast-vs-actual" | "/expense-budget"' — the sidebar navigates to /dashboard etc. but router likely mounts them at /. Consider aligning route paths.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetailDrawer renders Recharts inside a Sheet — verified visible at 1920 viewport. Cost bar chart appeared correctly.

BackupsTab: preview button uses testid `backup-view-{stamp}` (not `backup-preview-{stamp}`). Task description referred to it as 'Preview' — testid name is fine but the mismatch tripped my first selector; documented so next agents use `backup-view-*`.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing 9 backup snapshots and 12 project rows were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified testids: project-row-{id}, project-detail-drawer, pd-project-id, pd-total-revenue/cost/expense/net, pd-year-select, pd-tab-forecast/transactions/quotations, pd-forecast-table, pd-transactions-table, pd-quotations-table, copy-last-year-btn, copy-last-year-dialog, copy-target-year, copy-quotations-toggle, copy-overwrite-toggle, copy-run-btn, tab-backups, backup-impact-{stamp}, backup-view-{stamp} (row preview trigger), backup-preview-dialog, backup-preview-impact-merge, backup-preview-impact-full, dryrun-dialog. Confirmed dryrun-dialog header shows 'RESTORE MERGE' or 'RESTORE FULL' based on chosen mode. Copy-Last-Year target-year options overlap on label '2027' — use option value or index rather than name-based selectors.
